Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 136. Category: technique. Rank 1.

Rank 1 Ki technique
Ki Cost: 4
Prerequisites: none
Casting Time: 1 action
Range: 40 feet
Chargeable?: Yes
Duration: Instantaneous
Type: Beam
A small beam shot from the finger causes an
explosion on impact.
Targets in this 5 ft wide, 40 foot long line must make
a dexterity saving throw or take 3d4 force damage, half
on a successful save.
